detail.longDescription:
Learn to code, develop practical AI skills, or level up as a developer. Make progress in just a few minutes a day with Enki.

Whether you're new to programming, an experienced developer, or a professional using AI at work, Enki helps you build valuable skills through personalized lessons, hands-on challenges, and AI-powered feedback.

✨ LEARNING BUILT AROUND YOU

Tell Enki what you want to achieve and what you already know. Get relevant skill recommendations, choose where to begin, and follow a learning path that adapts as you progress.

🤖 YOUR PERSONAL AI TUTOR

Get guidance when you need it:

★  Ask questions and get clear explanations
★  Receive hints when you're stuck
★  Practice with interactive questions
★  Get feedback on your answers and code
★ Understand mistakes and learn how to improve

🦾 LEARN AI FOR WORK AND DEVELOPMENT

● AI for non-developers: Use AI tools more effectively at work
● AI for developers: Improve your AI-assisted coding workflows
● AI for students: Use AI tools to prepare for your career
● AI engineering: Explore how AI-powered applications are built
● Generative AI: Understand core concepts and practical use cases

🧑🏽‍💻 LEARN TO CODE AND LEVEL UP YOUR SKILLS

Start with coding basics or build on your programming experience:

● Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, Go, Swift, Kotlin, C++ and C#
● Frontend and web development with React, HTML and CSS
● Computer science fundamentals, Git, Docker, Linux and security
● Technical interview preparation and coding practice

📈 BUILD DATA AND NO-CODE SKILLS

Learn SQL, data analysis, spreadsheets and R. Explore productivity and no-code tools including Zapier, Airtable and Webflow.

👫 GROW TOGETHER WITH PEERS

You can also learn with others in your company, school, or the Enki community by:

● Engaging in discussions, mentoring other learners, and collaborating on exercises
● Teaming up with friends, co-workers, or peers and tracking each other's progress
● Sharing your favorite lessons with teammates or friends

💪🏼 PRACTICE A LITTLE. IMPROVE EVERY DAY.

Enki combines bite-sized lessons with active learning:

● Try questions and challenges at your level
● Get a hint, try again, and understand the answer
● Review what you've learned with spaced repetition
● Track progress, set daily goals, and build a learning habit

Whether your goal is to get started with Python, become a stronger developer, understand AI, or use technology more confidently at work, Enki gives you a practical place to start.

🌎 JOIN OVER 3 MILLION LEARNERS

Over 3 million people have used Enki to build and improve their coding, AI, data and other critical skills.

What the media say about us:

"The exercises on Enki are focused on making software developers more productive."
- Forbes

"Ever imagined yourself as a JavaScript whizz, or pulling no punches with Python? Want to get a handle on SQL, or let yourself loose with Linux? Then let Enki be your coding coach, setting you daily workouts that tackle the intricacies of coding languages in bite-sized steps."
- Featured as app of the day in 100+ countries

"Compared to free reading options this is structured, personalized content. Enki creates a 5-minute "workout" for software developers to learn important concepts in their spare time."
- TechCrunch

"The app supports everyone from beginners to more experienced coders. You can almost think of Enki the same way you would an exercise app. It provides you with daily workouts, but here you’re leveling up your coding skills instead of burning fat and building muscle."
- MakeUseOf

"Enki has one of the most accessible and attractive interfaces out there"
- Career Karma

To learn more, visit www.enki.com
